decisions.reason: A core safety shoe line launched only a year ago still has uncertain but plausible value, and keeping it costs little given in-house manufacturing, so the option stays open.
The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the shoe range, and one year of evidence is too little to justify abandoning it, though it overlaps with other insole options.
The supportive insole is cheap to keep in a large-inventory firm and its prospects are still unresolved, so it is retained while results accumulate.
Having its own page signals early commitment to the ergonomic series, which fits the firm's innovation direction, so dropping it now would forfeit a promising option.
Firefighter boots open a specialized niche with long procurement cycles, so value resolves slowly and the option should be kept while uncertainty remains.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page shows strong early signals and further commitment, so it is clearly kept.
